This update fixes some uncommon issues in the Collector Battles.

notes.title: Update Notes for April 15, 2025

Hello everyone,

This update brings more smooth collector battles!

More specifically:

[olist]

notes.title: Update Notes For April 14, 2025 - UI Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This patch brings some UI fixes to make the overall experience more smooth.

More specifically:

[olist]
[*] Removed "Ghost" cards and skills when Drag n Dropping or Placing cards or skills in their respective UI areas.
[*] Adjusted Dialogue Choice Box to match the maximum size of the choice options.
[*] Fixed a bug when not using a Gamepad that was skipping the navigation of some dialogue choices when the dialogue had more
than two dialogue choices.
[*] Fixed the skill addition or removal from the collection or applied skills to remember the last action and resume from the
correpsonding UI area.
[/olist]

See you in Caelum!

notes.title: Update Notes for April 14, 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This patch contains important fixes and additions to UI navigation that enchances the Gamepad support.

More specifically:

[olist]
[*] Pressing B on Gamepad now also closes Quick Menu, Store Shop Menu. Store Shop Menu now also closes with Esc key.
[*] Pressing B on Gamepad or Esc on Keyboard closes the expanded dropdown. If there isn't any the settigs it closes as intended.
[*] D-pad on Gamepad and arrows on Keyboard now can also be used to switch between dialog choices.
[*] Fixed a bug with Gamepad on Skills menu when having applied only one skill. Now it works as intended.
[*] Fixed a bug in KeyItems that prevented navigation with multiple key items.
[/olist]

See you in Caelum!

notes.title: Update Notes for April 11, 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

These series of updates are intended to refine and improve player direction and provide a more immersive experience.

More specifically:
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug where resetting player to last checkpoint was triggering if player had removed all Quick Hand cards. Now triggers properly on Battle Loss when the right conditions are met.
[/olist]

Stay tuned for more!

See you in Caelum!

notes.title: Update Notes for April 10, 2025

notes.title: Important Update - Please Read Below
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This is an important update, because it enhances the gameplay experience and gives even more life to the world of Caelum. It also includes several bug fixes and improvements, as well as some performance updates. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170712/74c8846a97535f53bd4dea7566829aa28b594dd3.png[/img]

[h1]New Things Added[/h1]

- Added rivers that can be traversed with various ways or are a part of the environment.
- Added forest trees as part of other assets or as standalone ones.
- Added Outside border regions to make areas less chaotic for new players without undermining the path choices that are already in play.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
- Ensured the unstucker is stable and will trigger on very rare occasions where physics force player to enter a collider. The unstucker then will quickly move player to a safe spot.
- Using the skill 'Blink' will now show the trail images of the correct sprite of the player spritesheet

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
- Improved the trail images of the player when using the skill 'Blink' by using a better smear effect based on player speed
- Now only updating the material of the player trail images just before activating the skill 'Blink' instead of the Update, increasing fps

IMPORTANT NOTE: If anyone has previously saved the game in an area that is now covered with outside border regions, a new game is required to continue the playthrough. This is a one time update that will not occur in the feature. The full game will already include all these enhancements and no new game will be required at that time.

The developer,
Petros Giannopoulos
